t: You're looking at The Dorchester, the five-star hotel on Park Lane, just east of Hyde Park. It opened on 18 April 1931 and still keeps its 1930s furnishings and ambiance. William Curtis Green, an architect who later won the Royal Gold Medal, designed it, along with engineer Owen Williams, known for the original Wembley Stadium. The comedian Kenneth Horne, of Round the Horne, died here, and the aviator Claude Ridley died here too. Businessman Sir William McAlpine was born here.
